dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.text: Aizhan! Can you hear us? We are all here for our Friday dinner!

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Yes, Mum! I can see you all! The food looks so delicious. What is it?

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.text: It's beshbarmak — your favourite! I made it especially for you.

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Oh, I miss your cooking so much! How are you, Mum?

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.text: I'm fine, dear. Very busy at the hospital, but happy. How is your food in Uralsk? Are you eating well?

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Yes, don't worry! The dormitory cafeteria has good food. Hi, Dad!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.text: Hi, my daughter! How are your studies going? Are your professors good?

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Yes, Dad! My English professor is excellent. Her name is Ms. Aigerim.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.text: Good. Study hard and make us proud. Your future career depends on it!

dialogue.speaker: Arman
dialogue.text: Hey Aizhan! Did you make any new friends?

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Yes! My best friend is Dias. He studies Computer Science, like you!

dialogue.speaker: Arman
dialogue.text: Great! Give him my advice — join the coding club. It helped me a lot!

dialogue.speaker: Dana
dialogue.text: Aizhan! Look at my new drawing! I drew our whole family!

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Dana, it's beautiful! You are so talented! I love the colours!

dialogue.speaker: Dana
dialogue.text: I miss you, sister! Come home soon, okay?

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: I miss you all too! See you at the holidays. I love you, family!

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.text: We love you too, Aizhan. Study well and sleep enough. Goodnight!
